theme: Vintage botanical greenhouse plants with brass fixtures

scout.suggestedAngle: Frame the book as a "Victorian Glasshouse Botanical Journal" — each page depicts a potted specimen inside an ornate greenhouse vignette, incorporating brass fixtures (spigots, hinges, plant stands, hanging planters, thermometers, watering cans) alongside the botanicals. This gives colorists a richer scene-based composition (not just isolated plant line art), appealing to fans of steampunk/vintage aesthetics, botanical illustration, and antique conservatory decor — a distinct visual niche versus typical single-flower or generic botanical coloring pages.
scout.selectionRationale:
This theme offers the best balance of evergreen, non-seasonal demand (botanical/nature coloring books sell consistently year-round vs. holiday-locked themes like Nordic winter scenes), strong differentiation from the oversaturated generic 'flower/botanical' coloring book market by layering in a distinctive vintage greenhouse/brass-fixture aesthetic, and broad crossover appeal to adult colorists who favor intricate nature illustration and vintage/cottagecore decor styles. It supports a large volume of unique page concepts (various plants, potting tools, greenhouse architecture details) without running into the higher saturation seen in steampunk-animal or art-deco-cityscape niches, while carrying lower seasonal risk and strong long-tail keyword opportunities on KDP.</selectionRationale>
